title: The World After the End
altTitles: หลังวันสิ้นโลก
description: One day, mysterious towers suddenly appear across the world, summoning humans to become Tower Walkers and fight monsters threatening humanity. When the Stone of Regression is discovered, most Walkers choose to return to the past and abandon the doomed timeline. Jae-Hwan, however, refuses to regress. Determined to continue fighting in the original world, he reaches the top of the Tower and begins uncovering the shocking truth behind the Tower, the Gods, and the world itself.
author: Sing-Shong / Undead Gamja
